blurb: Grayhawk Golf Club has two distinct golf courses: Talon, a desert-style course with thick Sonoran Desert and box canyons, and Raptor, a traditional course with generous fairways and deep bunkers. Both courses are highly acclaimed and have hosted professional and amateur tournaments. The club offers daily fee public golf, group outings, and a learning center with personalized instruction.
